status.en: 69 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 32% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Kabul and Peshawar.
status.nb: 69 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 32 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Peshawar.

summary.en: A passenger vehicle fell into a ravine in Torghar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killing eight and injuring seven, while a drug smuggler was killed in a CCD encounter in Jhang. China announced it will fly a Pakistani pilot as its first foreign astronaut, and Houthi forces have struck Riyadh's financial centre twice, prompting Pakistani condemnation. An explosion at a religious school in eastern Afghanistan killed one and injured two, and security forces killed three militants in an operation in Bannu. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et passasjervogn falt ned i en ravine i Torghar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, og drepte åtte og såret sju, mens en narkotikasmugler ble drept i et CCD-oppgjør i Jhang. Kina kunngjorde at de vil sende en pakistansk pilot som sin første utenlandske astronaut, og houthiene har angrepet Riyadhs finanssenter to ganger, noe som førte til pakistansk fordømmelse. En eksplosjon på en religiøs skole i Øst-Afghanistan drepte én og såret to, og sikkerhetsstyrker drepte tre militante i en operasjon i Bannu. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
